title: SOT Registry
description: Schema for .sot/registry.yaml — the user-committed source-of-truth registry. Every field is a pointer or provenance annotation; no field stores copied source content (no-copy invariant). Machine-generated fields — content hashes, drift status, machine timestamps — belong in the per-install drift cache, never in this committed file.

schema_version.description: Registry format version string (e.g. '1.0'). Human-set on init; increment when the schema itself changes. Never auto-bumped by the engine.

entries.description: Ordered list of SOT pointer-records. Each entry describes one boundary within the user's project. May be empty on a fresh registry.

exclude.description: Optional gitignore-style glob patterns committed alongside the registry (BP-039). Extends the engine's default exclude set so the identical file set is digested on every machine when computing directory tree-digests. Patterns are matched on the POSIX relative path.

docowners.description: Optional path (relative to the project root) to the DOCOWNERS doc↔code mapping file (BP-042 Pattern A). Defaults to '.sot/DOCOWNERS'. A pointer only; the file is consumed solely by the aim-sot engine for doc-drift correlation.

entry.description: A single SOT pointer-record. All fields are pointers or human-authored provenance metadata. No machine-generated values (hashes, timestamps, drift state) are defined here — those live in the per-install drift cache.

id.description: Stable, unique slug for this entry within the registry. Kebab-case recommended.

kind.description: Taxonomy of the boundary — what type of artifact this entry describes.

boundary_type.description: How the boundary is modelled: 'path' (directory glob, CODEOWNERS-style), 'component' (named unit with a co-located manifest, Backstage-style), or 'concern' (cross-cutting scope — an ADR, API contract, or shared platform concern).

sot_location.description: Pointer to the canonical truth location — a relative path, URL, or structured ref. This is a pointer, never a copy of the content itself.

owner.description: Human-readable owner handle (e.g. '@team-name' or a person handle). Human-authored; never auto-updated by the engine.

description.description: One-line human summary of what this boundary is and why it matters. Human-authored; must be re-confirmed by a human when a content-hash change (K1 trigger) is detected.

last_verified.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last human re-confirmation that this entry is still accurate. Low-churn: changes only when a person re-confirms the entry, never auto-bumped by the engine. Machine drift timestamps live in the per-install cache only.

added_by.description: Handle of the person or process (e.g. '@username' or 'aim-sot bootstrap') that originally added this entry.

provenance_note.description: Free-text human note explaining how or why this entry was added. Especially useful for entries added via detect-propose.

status.description: Lifecycle state. A 'superseded' entry should carry a forward pointer in docs_url or provenance_note indicating what replaced it.

source_repo.description: URL of the source repository for this boundary (pointer only).

docs_url.description: URL of the primary documentation for this boundary (pointer only).

api_spec.description: Path or URL to the API specification (e.g. OpenAPI file) for this boundary (pointer only).

ci_url.description: URL of the CI pipeline for this boundary (pointer only).

runbook_url.description: URL of the operational runbook for this boundary (pointer only).

dashboard_url.description: URL of the observability or metrics dashboard for this boundary (pointer only).

adr_dir.description: Path to the directory containing Architecture Decision Records for this boundary (pointer only).

links.description: Additional named pointer links for this boundary (BP-028 Part 3).

url.description: URL or path for this link (pointer only).

type.description: Optional classifier for the link kind (e.g. 'runbook', 'dashboard', 'ticket').

drift_check.description: Optional shell command or script path to verify this boundary is still accurate. Human-configured; the engine runs it but does not auto-generate or overwrite it.

drift_strategy.description: Optional override for how this boundary's drift digest is computed. Enum-selected built-in (NEVER a shell string): 'content-digest' (sha256 of a file), 'tree-digest' (BP-039 sorted-per-file-sha256 of a directory), 'git-tree-hash' (git's native tree hash, opt-in accelerator), 'git-ahead-behind' (ref boundaries), 'temporal' (date-only fallback). Defaults by boundary shape when absent (file -> content-digest, directory -> tree-digest). A change to this value re-baselines the entry; it never executes a shell command (verify S4 rejects any non-enum value).
